Name: Enemies Health Bars
Author: ethanhol
Description:
This mod has been created to display enemies health bars when playing to stardew valley. The bar displays using colors and life count indicator. The color change from green to red according to the ratio current life against max life.
The indicator will only display the health of enemies depending on the number of them have killed and your combat level.

[b]Installing[/b]

Please ensure first that you have installed [url=https://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]. To install this mod, please download the zip file and uncompress it in the mods folder of you Stardew Valley installation.

[b]Cross mod compatibility[/b]
This mod has compatibility with mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=files]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] that allow you to change the configuration of the mod ingame (from main menu or while playing). This is not required, if you don't use it, see next section about configuring the mod. The compatibility is checked on versions 1.5.1 and 1.6.

[b]Configuration[/b]
This mod has 4 configuration possibilities
[list]
[*]Invert coloring of the enemies life
[/list][list]
[*]Deactivate experience requirements on life display
[*]Hide lifebar if the ennemy's health is full
[*]Hide the lifebar text with health count
[/list]
To edit the configuration (if you don't have Generic Mod Config Menu), open the mods folder of your Stardew Valley installation and go inside EnemyHealthBars folder. Edit file config.json (start the mod once to make it appear) and :
[list]
[*]Set variable ColorScheme to 1 if you want to use alternative color scheme
[/list][list]
[*]Set variable EnableXPNeeded to false if you want to deactivate experience requirements.
[/list]
[b]Uninstalling[/b]

To uninstall this mod, just remove the folder EnemyHealthBars from you Stardew Valley mods folder.

[b]Languages[/b]
This mod is translated in english and french. If you wan't other languages, you can help by sending the content translated to let me add it the next version, send a pull request ion GitHub, or add you own mod translation on Nexus Mods.

[b]Improvements[/b]

I'll improve the portage as there are some display issues that I encountered and the design is not fully RP relatively to the game interface.
If you'd like to help me, or report bug on code, see the [url=https://github.com/TheThor59/StardewMods]GitHub﻿[/url].

[b]Credits[/b]

This mod is a portage of an existing outdated mod that was no longer compatible with latest version of Stardew Valley and SMAPI. The initial author is Maurício Gomes. Exisiting mod informations are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/193]here[/url] and initial sources are located [url=https://gitlab.com/speeder1/SMAPIHealthbarMod]here[/url].
